findings.evidence: 9 flat items, no sub-headings or nested items breaking them into groups.
findings.violation: This listing holds 9 items, more than 7 a reader can scan in one glance, with no subgrouping to break it up.
findings.fix: Split this listing into named subgroups, either nested sub-lists or sub-headings, each holding a smaller set of related items.

findings.evidence: Leaving this field at its default is the right choice for most teams, and raising it is worth doing only when a specific integration needs the extra room.
findings.violation: The timeout field description includes a recommendation about when to leave the default, rather than remaining purely descriptive of what the field accepts and its constraints.
findings.fix: Remove the recommendation and retain only the descriptive parts: 'The timeout field takes a duration in milliseconds, and the validator rejects any value below 1000.' Reserve design guidance for a companion how-to or explanation page.
